name: Intracom Holdings S.A.
summary: Intracom Holdings S.A. operates as an IT solutions and services company. The company offers IT, construction, and defense electronics solutions and services. It also engages in civil engineering, infrastructure, telecom network, renewable energy, and environmental construction, as well as real estate development activities. In addition, the company offers defense and security communication products, hybrid electric power generation and unmanned systems. Intracom Holdings S.A. was founded in 1977 and is based in Athens, Greece.
